WITH project_base AS (
 SELECT * FROM staging.stg_asana__project WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL
), joined AS (
 SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.created_at AS project_created_at,p.due_date AS project_due_date,p.owner_user_id AS project_owner,p.current_status AS project_status,p.team_id,
        pt.task_id,t.is_completed,t.assignee_user_id,pm.task_status_category,pm.performance_grade,pm.urgency_score,pm.health_score,pm.complexity_score,pm.days_open,pm.response_time_days,pm.delay_days,t.created_at task_created_at,t.completed_at
 FROM project_base p LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task rel ON p.project_id=rel.project_id::VARCHAR
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__task t ON rel.task_id::VARCHAR=t.task_id
 LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics pm ON t.task_id=pm.task_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, task_id FROM staging.stg_asana__project_task) pt ON pt.project_id=rel.project_id AND pt.task_id=rel.task_id
), agg AS (
 SELECT project_id,project_name,project_created_at,project_due_date,project_owner,project_status,team_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id)::BIGINT total_tasks,COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed)::BIGINT completed_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed=FALSE)::BIGINT active_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT assigned_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed=FALSE AND assignee_user_id IS NULL)::BIGINT unassigned_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_status_category='overdue')::BIGINT overdue_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade='poor')::BIGINT poor_performance_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE urgency_score>=4)::BIGINT high_urgency_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE delay_days>0)::BIGINT delayed_tasks,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade IN ('excellent','good'))::BIGINT quality_tasks,
 AVG(health_score) avg_task_health_score,AVG(complexity_score) avg_task_complexity,
 AVG(days_open) FILTER(WHERE is_completed) avg_completion_time_days,AVG(response_time_days) avg_response_time_days,
 MAX(days_open)::BIGINT max_task_age_days,AVG(delay_days) avg_delay_days,COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_user_id)::BIGINT unique_assignees,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_created_at>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '7 days')::BIGINT recent_task_creation,
 COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE completed_at>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '7 days')::BIGINT recent_task_completion
 FROM joined GROUP BY ALL
), pct AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND(100.0*completed_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) completion_percentage,ROUND(100.0*assigned_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) assignment_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*overdue_tasks/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) overdue_percentage,ROUND(100.0*quality_tasks/NULLIF(completed_tasks,0),2) quality_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*(overdue_tasks+poor_performance_tasks+delayed_tasks)/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) risk_percentage,
 ROUND(100.0*(recent_task_creation+recent_task_completion)/NULLIF(total_tasks,0),2) activity_percentage,
 DATE_DIFF('day',project_created_at::DATE,CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT project_age_days,
 CASE WHEN project_due_date IS NULL THEN 'no_deadline' WHEN project_due_date::DATE>CURRENT_DATE THEN 'on_time' WHEN project_due_date::DATE=CURRENT_DATE THEN 'due_today' ELSE 'overdue' END deadline_status,
 DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,project_due_date::DATE)::BIGINT days_to_deadline FROM agg
), scores AS (
 SELECT *,COALESCE(completion_percentage,0) cp,COALESCE(assignment_percentage,0) ap,COALESCE(overdue_percentage,0) op,COALESCE(quality_percentage,0) qp,COALESCE(risk_percentage,0) rp,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks=0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(completion_percentage,0) END cpct,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(completion_percentage,0)>=90 THEN 25 WHEN completion_percentage>=75 THEN 20 WHEN completion_percentage>=50 THEN 15 WHEN completion_percentage>=25 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END progress_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(quality_percentage,0)>=90 THEN 25 WHEN quality_percentage>=75 THEN 20 WHEN quality_percentage>=60 THEN 15 WHEN quality_percentage>=40 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END quality_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(risk_percentage,0)<=5 THEN 25 WHEN risk_percentage<=10 THEN 20 WHEN risk_percentage<=20 THEN 15 WHEN risk_percentage<=35 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END risk_score,
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(assignment_percentage,0)>=95 AND unique_assignees>=2 THEN 25 WHEN assignment_percentage>=85 THEN 20 WHEN assignment_percentage>=70 THEN 15 WHEN assignment_percentage>=50 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END resource_score
 FROM pct
), labels AS (
 SELECT *, progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score AS overall_health_score,
 CASE WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=90 THEN 'excellent' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=75 THEN 'good' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=60 THEN 'fair' WHEN progress_score+quality_score+risk_score+resource_score>=40 THEN 'poor' ELSE 'critical' END health_grade,
 CASE WHEN risk_percentage>=50 OR overdue_percentage>=30 THEN 'high_risk' WHEN risk_percentage>=25 OR overdue_percentage>=15 THEN 'medium_risk' WHEN risk_percentage>=10 OR overdue_percentage>=5 THEN 'low_risk' ELSE 'minimal_risk' END risk_level,
 CASE WHEN deadline_status='overdue' THEN 'overdue' WHEN risk_percentage>=40 AND days_to_deadline<=7 THEN 'at_risk' WHEN completion_percentage>=75 AND risk_percentage<=15 THEN 'on_track' WHEN completion_percentage>=50 AND risk_percentage<=25 THEN 'progressing' WHEN completion_percentage>=25 THEN 'slow_progress' ELSE 'stalled' END project_forecast,
 concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN progress_score<15 THEN 'progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_score<15 THEN 'quality' END,CASE WHEN risk_score<15 THEN 'risk_management' END,CASE WHEN resource_score<15 THEN 'resource_allocation' END,CASE WHEN overdue_percentage>20 THEN 'deadline_management' END,CASE WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unassigned_tasks>0.3*total_tasks THEN 'task_assignment' END) focus_areas
 FROM scores
), final AS (
 SELECT *, total_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks<=total_tasks AND completion_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND quality_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND overall_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AS is_valid_record,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks=0 THEN 'no_tasks' WHEN completion_percentage=100 AND project_status<>'completed' THEN 'status_mismatch' WHEN overdue_percentage>50 THEN 'excessive_overdue' WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unassigned_tasks>0.5*total_tasks THEN 'poor_assignment' WHEN project_age_days>365 AND completion_percentage<25 THEN 'stale_project' ELSE 'normal' END anomaly_flag
 FROM labels
)
SELECT project_id,project_name,project_created_at,project_due_date,project_owner,project_status,team_id,total_tasks,completed_tasks,active_tasks,assigned_tasks,unassigned_tasks,overdue_tasks,poor_performance_tasks,high_urgency_tasks,delayed_tasks,quality_tasks,avg_task_health_score,avg_task_complexity,avg_completion_time_days,avg_response_time_days,max_task_age_days,avg_delay_days,unique_assignees,recent_task_creation,recent_task_completion,
 COALESCE(completion_percentage,0)::DOUBLE completion_percentage,COALESCE(assignment_percentage,0)::DOUBLE assignment_percentage,COALESCE(overdue_percentage,0)::DOUBLE overdue_percentage,COALESCE(quality_percentage,0)::DOUBLE quality_percentage,COALESCE(risk_percentage,0)::DOUBLE risk_percentage,COALESCE(activity_percentage,0)::DOUBLE activity_percentage,project_age_days,deadline_status,days_to_deadline,progress_score,quality_score,risk_score,resource_score,overall_health_score,health_grade,risk_level,project_forecast,focus_areas,is_valid_record,anomaly_flag
FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY overall_health_score DESC,project_id

scopes.select_sql: SELECT project_id, project_name, project_created_at, project_due_date, project_owner, project_status, team_id, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) AS BIGINT) AS total_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed) AS BIGINT) AS completed_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed = FALSE) AS BIGINT) AS active_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS assigned_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE is_completed = FALSE AND assignee_user_id IS NULL) AS BIGINT) AS unassigned_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_status_category = 'overdue') AS BIGINT) AS overdue_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade = 'poor') AS BIGINT) AS poor_performance_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE urgency_score >= 4) AS BIGINT) AS high_urgency_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE delay_days > 0) AS BIGINT) AS delayed_tasks, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE performance_grade IN ('excellent', 'good')) AS BIGINT) AS quality_tasks, AVG(health_score) AS avg_task_health_score, AVG(complexity_score) AS avg_task_complexity, AVG(days_open) FILTER(WHERE is_completed) AS avg_completion_time_days, AVG(response_time_days) AS avg_response_time_days, CAST(MAX(days_open) AS BIGINT) AS max_task_age_days, AVG(delay_days) AS avg_delay_days, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT assignee_user_id) AS BIGINT) AS unique_assignees, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE task_created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7' DAYS) AS BIGINT) AS recent_task_creation, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT task_id) FILTER(WHERE completed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7' DAYS) AS BIGINT) AS recent_task_completion FROM joined GROUP BY ALL

SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * completed_tasks / NULLIF(total_tasks, 0), 2) AS completion_percentage, ROUND(100.0 * assigned_tasks / NULLIF(total_tasks, 0), 2) AS assignment_percentage, ROUND(100.0 * overdue_tasks / NULLIF(total_tasks, 0), 2) AS overdue_percentage, ROUND(100.0 * quality_tasks / NULLIF(completed_tasks, 0), 2) AS quality_percentage, ROUND(100.0 * (overdue_tasks + poor_performance_tasks + delayed_tasks) / NULLIF(total_tasks, 0), 2) AS risk_percentage, ROUND(100.0 * (recent_task_creation + recent_task_completion) / NULLIF(total_tasks, 0), 2) AS activity_percentage, CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(project_created_at AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) AS project_age_days, CASE WHEN project_due_date IS NULL THEN 'no_deadline' WHEN CAST(project_due_date AS DATE) > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'on_time' WHEN CAST(project_due_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'due_today' ELSE 'overdue' END AS deadline_status, CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, CAST(project_due_date AS DATE)) AS BIGINT) AS days_to_deadline FROM agg

SELECT *, COALESCE(completion_percentage, 0) AS cp, COALESCE(assignment_percentage, 0) AS ap, COALESCE(overdue_percentage, 0) AS op, COALESCE(quality_percentage, 0) AS qp, COALESCE(risk_percentage, 0) AS rp, CASE WHEN total_tasks = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(completion_percentage, 0) END AS cpct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(completion_percentage, 0) >= 90 THEN 25 WHEN completion_percentage >= 75 THEN 20 WHEN completion_percentage >= 50 THEN 15 WHEN completion_percentage >= 25 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS progress_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(quality_percentage, 0) >= 90 THEN 25 WHEN quality_percentage >= 75 THEN 20 WHEN quality_percentage >= 60 THEN 15 WHEN quality_percentage >= 40 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS quality_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(risk_percentage, 0) <= 5 THEN 25 WHEN risk_percentage <= 10 THEN 20 WHEN risk_percentage <= 20 THEN 15 WHEN risk_percentage <= 35 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS risk_score, CASE WHEN COALESCE(assignment_percentage, 0) >= 95 AND unique_assignees >= 2 THEN 25 WHEN assignment_percentage >= 85 THEN 20 WHEN assignment_percentage >= 70 THEN 15 WHEN assignment_percentage >= 50 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END AS resource_score FROM pct

SELECT *, progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score AS overall_health_score, CASE WHEN progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score >= 90 THEN 'excellent' WHEN progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score >= 75 THEN 'good' WHEN progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score >= 60 THEN 'fair' WHEN progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score >= 40 THEN 'poor' ELSE 'critical' END AS health_grade, CASE WHEN risk_percentage >= 50 OR overdue_percentage >= 30 THEN 'high_risk' WHEN risk_percentage >= 25 OR overdue_percentage >= 15 THEN 'medium_risk' WHEN risk_percentage >= 10 OR overdue_percentage >= 5 THEN 'low_risk' ELSE 'minimal_risk' END AS risk_level, CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'overdue' THEN 'overdue' WHEN risk_percentage >= 40 AND days_to_deadline <= 7 THEN 'at_risk' WHEN completion_percentage >= 75 AND risk_percentage <= 15 THEN 'on_track' WHEN completion_percentage >= 50 AND risk_percentage <= 25 THEN 'progressing' WHEN completion_percentage >= 25 THEN 'slow_progress' ELSE 'stalled' END AS project_forecast, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN progress_score < 15 THEN 'progress' END, CASE WHEN quality_score < 15 THEN 'quality' END, CASE WHEN risk_score < 15 THEN 'risk_management' END, CASE WHEN resource_score < 15 THEN 'resource_allocation' END, CASE WHEN overdue_percentage > 20 THEN 'deadline_management' END, CASE WHEN total_tasks > 0 AND unassigned_tasks > 0.3 * total_tasks THEN 'task_assignment' END) AS focus_areas FROM scores

SELECT *, total_tasks >= 0 AND completed_tasks <= total_tasks AND completion_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND quality_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND overall_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AS is_valid_record, CASE WHEN total_tasks = 0 THEN 'no_tasks' WHEN completion_percentage = 100 AND project_status <> 'completed' THEN 'status_mismatch' WHEN overdue_percentage > 50 THEN 'excessive_overdue' WHEN total_tasks > 0 AND unassigned_tasks > 0.5 * total_tasks THEN 'poor_assignment' WHEN project_age_days > 365 AND completion_percentage < 25 THEN 'stale_project' ELSE 'normal' END AS anomaly_flag FROM labels

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_asana__project_health_indicators
      description: Project-level health indicators derived from Asana projects and tasks with validated scores, percentages, and risk/forecast labels
      grain: One row per project_id (validated records only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project (project_id, project_name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id)
      - staging.stg_asana__task (task_id, created_at, completed_at, is_completed, assignee_user_id)
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task (project_id, task_id)
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_id, task_status_category, performance_grade, urgency_score, health_score, complexity_score, days_open, response_time_days, delay_days)
      business_logic: '1) Project and task filters: - project_base: projects where project_name and created_at are not null. - task_base: tasks where created_at is not null. - project_task_relation: all project-task links. - task_performance: all task performance metrics. 2) Project_task_stats (one row per project): - Left join p→ptr on project_id, then to t on task_id, then to tp on task_id. - Distinct task counts by project: • total_tasks: all linked tasks. • completed_tasks: tasks with is_completed = true. • active_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false. • assigned_tasks: tasks with non-null assignee_user_id. • unassigned_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false and null assignee_user_id. - Risk counts (distinct tasks): overdue (status_category=''overdue''), poor performance (grade=''poor''), high urgency (urgency_score ≥ 4), delayed (delay_days > 0). - Quality: • quality_tasks: performance_grade in {excellent, good}. • Averages: health_score, complexity_score (NULLs ignored). - Time metrics: • avg_completion_time_days: avg days_open over completed tasks; NULL if none. • avg_response_time_days: avg response_time_days; NULLs ignored. • max_task_age_days: max days_open; NULL if none. • avg_delay_days: avg delay_days; includes zeros; NULLs ignored. - Collaboration/recency: • unique_assignees: distinct assignee_user_id (non-null). • recent_task_creation: tasks created within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). • recent_task_completion: tasks completed within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). - Also select project attributes: id, name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id. 3) project_health_metrics: - Percentages rounded to 2 decimals; when denominator is 0, set to 0: • completion_percentage = completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • assignment_percentage = assigned_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • overdue_percentage = overdue_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • quality_percentage = quality_tasks / completed_tasks * 100. • risk_percentage = (overdue + poor_performance + delayed) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when categories overlap). • activity_percentage = (recent_task_creation + recent_task_completion) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when both occur for the same task). - project_age_days = days from project_created_at to current_date. - deadline_status: no_deadline if due_date is null; on_time if due_date > today; due_today if equal; else overdue. - days_to_deadline: days from today to due_date; negative if past due; NULL if no due date. 4) project_health_scores (each clamped to [0,25]): - progress_score by completion_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥50→15; ≥25→10; else 5. - quality_score by quality_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥60→15; ≥40→10; else 5. - risk_score by risk_percentage (lower is better): ≤5→25; ≤10→20; ≤20→15; ≤35→10; else 5. - resource_score by assignment_percentage (and diversity): ≥95 and unique_assignees ≥ 2→25; else ≥85→20; ≥70→15; ≥50→10; else 5. 5) final_health_assessment: - overall_health_score = progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score (0–100). - health_grade: ≥90 excellent; ≥75 good; ≥60 fair; ≥40 poor; else critical. - risk_level (top-down): high_risk if risk_percentage ≥50 or overdue_percentage ≥30; else medium_risk if risk_percentage ≥25 or overdue_percentage ≥15; else low_risk if risk_percentage ≥10 or overdue_percentage ≥5; else minimal_risk. - project_forecast (top-down): overdue if deadline_status=''overdue''; else at_risk if risk_percentage ≥40 and days_to_deadline ≤ 7; else on_track if completion_percentage ≥75 and risk_percentage ≤15; else progressing if completion_percentage ≥50 and risk_percentage ≤25; else slow_progress if completion_percentage ≥25; else stalled. - focus_areas: concatenate applicable labels in fixed order [progress, quality, risk_management, resource_allocation, deadline_management, task_assignment] using ", "; include a label when its condition holds (score < 15; overdue_percentage > 20; unassigned_tasks > 30% of total); trim trailing delimiter; empty string if none. 6) validated_results and output: - is_valid_record = true only if project_id present; project_name non-empty; total_tasks ≥ 0; completed_tasks ≤ total_tasks; completion_percentage and quality_percentage in [0,100]; overall_health_score in [0,100]. - anomaly_flag: ''no_tasks'' if total_tasks=0; ''status_mismatch'' if completion_percentage=100 and project_status!=''completed''; ''excessive_overdue'' if overdue_percentage>50; ''poor_assignment'' if unassigned_tasks > 50% of total; ''stale_project'' if project_age_days>365 and completion_percentage<25; else ''normal''. - Final output filters to is_valid_record = true and orders by overall_health_score descending, then project_id.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asana project identifier; grouping key for one output row per project
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name as in Asana (non-null in input filter)
      - name: project_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the project was created; used to compute project_age_days
      - name: project_due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project due date; drives deadline_status and days_to_deadline (can be NULL)
      - name: project_owner
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user ID from project record
      - name: project_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current project status from project record
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Associated team identifier from project record
      - name: total_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of tasks linked to the project via project_task; includes all tasks
      - name: completed_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where is_completed = true
      - name: active_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where is_completed = false
      - name: assigned_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks with non-null assignee_user_id
      - name: unassigned_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of active project tasks (is_completed = false) with NULL assignee_user_id
      - name: overdue_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where task_status_category = 'overdue'
      - name: poor_performance_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where performance_grade = 'poor'
      - name: high_urgency_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where urgency_score >= 4
      - name: delayed_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where delay_days > 0
      - name: quality_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks where performance_grade in ('excellent','good')
      - name: avg_task_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of health_score across project tasks; simple mean; ignores NULLs
      - name: avg_task_complexity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of complexity_score across project tasks; simple mean; ignores NULLs
      - name: avg_completion_time_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days_open for tasks with is_completed = true; NULL if none; ignores NULLs
      - name: avg_response_time_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average response_time_days across project tasks; days; ignores NULLs
      - name: max_task_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Maximum days_open across project tasks; days; NULL if no tasks
      - name: avg_delay_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average delay_days across project tasks; days; includes zeros; ignores NULLs
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of non-null assignee_user_id across project tasks
      - name: recent_task_creation
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks created in the last 7 days relative to current_date
      - name: recent_task_completion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project tasks completed in the last 7 days relative to current_date
      - name: completion_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completed_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: assignment_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Assigned_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: overdue_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overdue_tasks/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: quality_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Quality_tasks/Completed_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if completed_tasks=0; bounded 0–100
      - name: risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: (Overdue+Poor_performance+Delayed)/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; may exceed 100 when categories overlap
      - name: activity_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: (Recent_creation+Recent_completion)/Total_tasks*100 rounded to 2 decimals; 0 if total_tasks=0; may exceed 100 when both occur for the same task
      - name: project_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from project_created_at to current_date; non-negative integer
      - name: deadline_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: One of 'no_deadline','on_time','due_today','overdue' based on project_due_date vs current_date
      - name: days_to_deadline
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from current_date to project_due_date; negative if overdue; NULL if no due date
      - name: progress_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score 0–25 by completion_percentage: ≥90→25, ≥75→20, ≥50→15, ≥25→10, else 5'

specification.name: int_asana__project_health_indicators
specification.description: Project-level health indicators derived from Asana projects and tasks with validated scores, percentages, and risk/forecast labels
specification.grain: One row per project_id (validated records only)
source_models: staging.stg_asana__project (project_id, project_name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id)
intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_id, task_status_category, performance_grade, urgency_score, health_score, complexity_score, days_open, response_time_days, delay_days)
specification.business_logic: 1) Project and task filters: - project_base: projects where project_name and created_at are not null. - task_base: tasks where created_at is not null. - project_task_relation: all project-task links. - task_performance: all task performance metrics. 2) Project_task_stats (one row per project): - Left join p→ptr on project_id, then to t on task_id, then to tp on task_id. - Distinct task counts by project: • total_tasks: all linked tasks. • completed_tasks: tasks with is_completed = true. • active_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false. • assigned_tasks: tasks with non-null assignee_user_id. • unassigned_tasks: tasks with is_completed = false and null assignee_user_id. - Risk counts (distinct tasks): overdue (status_category='overdue'), poor performance (grade='poor'), high urgency (urgency_score ≥ 4), delayed (delay_days > 0). - Quality: • quality_tasks: performance_grade in {excellent, good}. • Averages: health_score, complexity_score (NULLs ignored). - Time metrics: • avg_completion_time_days: avg days_open over completed tasks; NULL if none. • avg_response_time_days: avg response_time_days; NULLs ignored. • max_task_age_days: max days_open; NULL if none. • avg_delay_days: avg delay_days; includes zeros; NULLs ignored. - Collaboration/recency: • unique_assignees: distinct assignee_user_id (non-null). • recent_task_creation: tasks created within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). • recent_task_completion: tasks completed within the last 7 days (relative to current_date). - Also select project attributes: id, name, created_at, due_date, owner_user_id, current_status, team_id. 3) project_health_metrics: - Percentages rounded to 2 decimals; when denominator is 0, set to 0: • completion_percentage = completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • assignment_percentage = assigned_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • overdue_percentage = overdue_tasks / total_tasks * 100. • quality_percentage = quality_tasks / completed_tasks * 100. • risk_percentage = (overdue + poor_performance + delayed) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when categories overlap). • activity_percentage = (recent_task_creation + recent_task_completion) / total_tasks * 100 (may exceed 100 when both occur for the same task). - project_age_days = days from project_created_at to current_date. - deadline_status: no_deadline if due_date is null; on_time if due_date > today; due_today if equal; else overdue. - days_to_deadline: days from today to due_date; negative if past due; NULL if no due date. 4) project_health_scores (each clamped to [0,25]): - progress_score by completion_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥50→15; ≥25→10; else 5. - quality_score by quality_percentage: ≥90→25; ≥75→20; ≥60→15; ≥40→10; else 5. - risk_score by risk_percentage (lower is better): ≤5→25; ≤10→20; ≤20→15; ≤35→10; else 5. - resource_score by assignment_percentage (and diversity): ≥95 and unique_assignees ≥ 2→25; else ≥85→20; ≥70→15; ≥50→10; else 5. 5) final_health_assessment: - overall_health_score = progress_score + quality_score + risk_score + resource_score (0–100). - health_grade: ≥90 excellent; ≥75 good; ≥60 fair; ≥40 poor; else critical. - risk_level (top-down): high_risk if risk_percentage ≥50 or overdue_percentage ≥30; else medium_risk if risk_percentage ≥25 or overdue_percentage ≥15; else low_risk if risk_percentage ≥10 or overdue_percentage ≥5; else minimal_risk. - project_forecast (top-down): overdue if deadline_status='overdue'; else at_risk if risk_percentage ≥40 and days_to_deadline ≤ 7; else on_track if completion_percentage ≥75 and risk_percentage ≤15; else progressing if completion_percentage ≥50 and risk_percentage ≤25; else slow_progress if completion_percentage ≥25; else stalled. - focus_areas: concatenate applicable labels in fixed order [progress, quality, risk_management, resource_allocation, deadline_management, task_assignment] using ", "; include a label when its condition holds (score < 15; overdue_percentage > 20; unassigned_tasks > 30% of total); trim trailing delimiter; empty string if none. 6) validated_results and output: - is_valid_record = true only if project_id present; project_name non-empty; total_tasks ≥ 0; completed_tasks ≤ total_tasks; completion_percentage and quality_percentage in [0,100]; overall_health_score in [0,100]. - anomaly_flag: 'no_tasks' if total_tasks=0; 'status_mismatch' if completion_percentage=100 and project_status!='completed'; 'excessive_overdue' if overdue_percentage>50; 'poor_assignment' if unassigned_tasks > 50% of total; 'stale_project' if project_age_days>365 and completion_percentage<25; else 'normal'. - Final output filters to is_valid_record = true and orders by overall_health_score descending, then project_id.

agent_sql.raw_text:
WITH assignments AS (
    SELECT target_task_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_assigned_at, MAX(created_at) AS last_assigned_at
    FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken = 'assigned' GROUP BY target_task_id
)
SELECT t.task_id, t.is_completed, t.completed_at, t.assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AS is_currently_assigned,
       a.first_assigned_at IS NOT NULL AS has_been_assigned, a.last_assigned_at, a.first_assigned_at,
       CASE WHEN t.created_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', t.created_at, CASE WHEN t.is_completed THEN t.completed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END) END::BIGINT AS days_open,
       CASE WHEN a.last_assigned_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', a.last_assigned_at, CASE WHEN t.is_completed THEN t.completed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END) END::BIGINT AS days_since_last_assignment,
       CASE WHEN a.first_assigned_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATE_DIFF('day', a.first_assigned_at, CASE WHEN t.is_completed THEN t.completed_at ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END) END::BIGINT AS days_since_first_assignment
FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN assignments a ON t.task_id = a.target_task_id

- name: int_asana__task_open_length
      description: Task open-length and assignment timing metrics derived from tasks and assignment stories.
      grain: One row per task_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_asana__task (one row per task). - From intermediate.int_asana__task_story, keep only rows where action_taken = ''assigned''; for each target_task_id compute: - first_assigned_at = earliest created_at - last_assigned_at = latest created_at - Left join the grouped assignments to tasks on task_id. - Flags: - is_currently_assigned = TRUE if assignee_user_id is present; else FALSE. - has_been_assigned = TRUE if any ''assigned'' story exists for the task; else FALSE. - Day-count metrics return an integer number of full days (partial days are not counted) and use the current timestamp at query execution for in-progress cases: - days_open: - If the task is completed: full days from task.created_at to task.completed_at - Else: full days from task.created_at to the current timestamp - days_since_last_assignment: - If last_assigned_at exists: - If the task is completed: full days from last_assigned_at to task.completed_at - Else: full days from last_assigned_at to the current timestamp - If last_assigned_at is missing: NULL - days_since_first_assignment: - If first_assigned_at exists: - If the task is completed: full days from first_assigned_at to task.completed_at - Else: full days from first_assigned_at to the current timestamp - If first_assigned_at is missing: NULL - If a required start or end timestamp is missing, the related day-count metric is NULL.'

      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique task identifier; exactly one output row per task_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

        data_type: BOOLEAN

        description: Latest assignment timestamp from stories with action 'assigned'; NULL if none.
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest assignment timestamp from stories with action 'assigned'; NULL if none.

        description: Full days from task.created_at to completed_at if completed, otherwise to the current timestamp.

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Full days from last_assigned_at to completed_at if completed, otherwise to the current timestamp; NULL if never assigned.

agent_sql.raw_text:
WITH tasks AS (
 SELECT t.*, ol.days_open, ol.days_since_first_assignment, ol.days_since_last_assignment,
        a.first_assigned_at,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.created_at) FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story s WHERE s.target_task_id=t.task_id), t.created_at) AS latest_story_at
 FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length ol ON t.task_id=ol.task_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT target_task_id, MIN(created_at) first_assigned_at FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken='assigned' GROUP BY target_task_id) a ON t.task_id=a.target_task_id
 WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL
), calculated AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'unassigned'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'assigned_active'
 WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE <= due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_on_time'
 WHEN is_completed AND completed_at::DATE > due_date::DATE THEN 'completed_late'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND due_date::DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'active' END AS task_status_category,
 CASE WHEN due_date IS NOT NULL AND is_completed AND completed_at::DATE > due_date::DATE THEN DATE_DIFF('day',due_date::DATE,completed_at::DATE)
      WHEN due_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_completed AND due_date::DATE < CURRENT_DATE THEN DATE_DIFF('day',due_date::DATE,CURRENT_DATE) ELSE 0 END::BIGINT AS delay_days,
 CASE WHEN first_assigned_at IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('day',created_at,first_assigned_at) END::BIGINT AS response_time_days,
 CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=1 THEN 5 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=3 THEN 4 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=7 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',latest_story_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)<=14 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS activity_score,
 CASE WHEN due_date IS NULL OR is_completed THEN 1 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=1 THEN 5 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=3 THEN 4 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=7 THEN 3 WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,due_date::DATE)<=30 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS urgency_score,
 CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(task_description,''))>500 THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(task_description,''))>100 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS complexity_score
 FROM tasks
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, (task_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(task_name))>0 AND days_open>=0 AND (response_time_days IS NULL OR response_time_days>=0) AND delay_days>=0) AS is_valid_record,
 CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 AND response_time_days<=1 THEN 'excellent'
 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=2 AND response_time_days<=2 THEN 'good'
 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=5 THEN 'fair' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days>5 THEN 'poor'
 WHEN NOT is_completed AND task_status_category='overdue' THEN 'at_risk' ELSE 'pending' END AS performance_grade,
 GREATEST(0,LEAST(100,activity_score*20 + CASE WHEN delay_days=0 THEN 25 ELSE GREATEST(0,25-delay_days*5) END + CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,25-response_time_days*3) END + CASE WHEN assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 15 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(task_description,'')<>'' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END))::BIGINT AS health_score
 FROM calculated
)

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      description: Task performance metrics with lifecycle status, response/delay days, activity/urgency/complexity scores, validity flag, performance grade, and health score; only valid records are output.
      grain: One row per task_id (only records with is_valid_record = true)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      business_logic: 'Data preparation: - Use tasks where created_at is present from staging.stg_asana__task. - Bring per-task durations from intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length (days_open, days_since_first_assignment, days_since_last_assignment). - Use stories from intermediate.int_asana__task_story where action_taken is present. Timeline and status: - For each task_id, left join open-length metrics. - Assign task_status_category using ordered rules: - unassigned: no assignee and not completed - assigned_active: has assignee and not completed - completed_on_time: completed_at on or before due_date - completed_late: completed_at after due_date - overdue: not completed and today is after the due_date’s calendar date - otherwise active - first_assigned_at: the earliest story timestamp where action_taken = ''assigned'' for this task; null if none. - last_activity_at: the later of modified_at and the latest story timestamp for the task; if no story exists, use created_at. Metrics: - response_time_days: number of days from created_at to first_assigned_at when first_assigned_at exists; otherwise null (expected non-negative). - delay_days: - If due_date exists and the task is completed late: days between due_date and completed_at. - If due_date exists and the task is still open and past due today: days between due_date and today. - Otherwise 0 (never negative). - activity_score (1–5) based on days since last_activity_at: - 0–1 days → 5; 2–3 → 4; 4–7 → 3; 8–14 → 2; else 1. - urgency_score (1–5) only when due_date exists and the task is not completed: - due in 0–1 days → 5; 2–3 → 4; 4–7 → 3; 8–30 → 2; else 1; otherwise 1. - complexity_score (1–3) from description length (treat missing description as empty): - >500 chars → 3; >100 → 2; else 1. Constraints and classifications: - is_valid_record is true only if task_name is not blank, created_at is present, days_open ≥ 0, response_time_days is not negative (null allowed), and delay_days ≥ 0. - performance_grade: - completed with delay_days = 0 and response_time_days ≤ 1 → excellent - completed with delay_days ≤ 2 and response_time_days ≤ 2 → good - completed with delay_days ≤ 5 → fair - completed with delay_days > 5 → poor - not completed and status is overdue → at_risk - otherwise pending. Health score: - Start from 0 and add components, then clamp to [0,100]: - Activity: add 20 points per activity_score unit (1–5). - Timeliness: add 25 if delay_days = 0; otherwise subtract 5 points per day of delay down to 0. - Responsiveness: add 25 if response_time_days ≤ 1; otherwise subtract 3 points per day down to 0. - Assignment: add 15 if an assignee is present; else 0. - Description: add 15 if description is present; else 0. Output: - Return rows with is_valid_record = true. - Sort by health_score (descending), then urgency_score (descending), then task_id.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique task identifier; exactly one output row per task_id that passes validity checks
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task display name/title sourced from stg_asana__task; must be non-null and non-blank
      - name: task_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task description text from stg_asana__task; presence contributes to health_score
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Original task creation timestamp; non-null by filter and used in multiple day-based calculations
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Most recent task modification timestamp used to determine last_activity_at; may be null
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the task was completed; used to label completed_on_time vs completed_late and to compute delay_days
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Target due timestamp used for status, urgency_score, and delay_days; overdue checks compare the due date’s calendar date to today
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Completion flag from stg_asana__task used in status, delay_days, urgency_score, and performance_grade
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Assigned user id (nullable); presence affects status and adds +15 to health_score
      - name: task_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle status from ordered rules: unassigned, assigned_active, completed_on_time, completed_late, overdue, or active'
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest story timestamp where action_taken='assigned' for this task; null if never assigned
      - name: last_activity_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Later of modified_at and the latest story timestamp; if no story exists, uses created_at
      - name: days_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Non-negative days the task has been open sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: days_since_first_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the first assignment sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: days_since_last_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent assignment sourced from int_asana__task_open_length
      - name: response_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from created_at to first_assigned_at; null if never assigned; must not be negative
      - name: delay_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days overdue (0 if due_date absent or on time); completed late uses days between due_date and completed_at; open overdue uses days between due_date and today
      - name: activity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 score based on days since last_activity_at vs now (≤1→5, ≤3→4, ≤7→3, ≤14→2, else 1)
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 score when due_date present and not completed, based on days until due_date thresholds; otherwise 1
      - name: complexity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '1–3 score based on description length: >500→3, >100→2, else 1'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only if task_name not blank, created_at present, and days_open/response_time_days/delay_days are not negative
        tests:
        - accepted_values:
            values:
            - true
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: excellent, good, fair, poor, at_risk, or pending per rules combining completion, delay_days, and response_time_days'
      - name: health_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Overall 0–100 score from weighted components (activity, timeliness, responsiveness, assignment, description) clamped to [0,100]

Constraints and classifications: - is_valid_record is true only if task_name is not blank, created_at is present, days_open ≥ 0, response_time_days is not negative (null allowed), and delay_days ≥ 0. - performance_grade: - completed with delay_days = 0 and response_time_days ≤ 1 → excellent - completed with delay_days ≤ 2 and response_time_days ≤ 2 → good - completed with delay_days ≤ 5 → fair - completed with delay_days > 5 → poor - not completed and status is overdue → at_risk - otherwise pending. Health score: - Start from 0 and add components, then clamp to [0,100]: - Activity: add 20 points per activity_score unit (1–5). - Timeliness: add 25 if delay_days = 0; otherwise subtract 5 points per day of delay down to 0. - Responsiveness: add 25 if response_time_days ≤ 1; otherwise subtract 3 points per day down to 0. - Assignment: add 15 if an assignee is present; else 0. - Description: add 15 if description is present; else 0. Output: - Return rows with is_valid_record = true. - Sort by health_score (descending), then urgency_score (descending), then task_id.

columns.name: complexity_score

columns.description: True only if task_name not blank, created_at present, and days_open/response_time_days/delay_days are not negative

columns.name: performance_grade
columns.description: Classification: excellent, good, fair, poor, at_risk, or pending per rules combining completion, delay_days, and response_time_days

WITH task_projects_base AS (
 SELECT pt.task_id, p.project_id, p.project_name, COALESCE(s.section_name, '(no section)') AS section_name
 FROM staging.stg_asana__project_task pt
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project p ON pt.project_id::VARCHAR = p.project_id
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__task_section ts ON pt.task_id::VARCHAR = ts.task_id::VARCHAR
 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__section s ON ts.section_id::VARCHAR = s.section_id
)
SELECT task_id, STRING_AGG(project_id, ', ' ORDER BY project_id) AS project_ids,
       STRING_AGG(project_name, ', ' ORDER BY project_name) AS project_names,
       STRING_AGG(project_name || ' (' || section_name || ')', ', ' ORDER BY project_name) FILTER (WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL) AS projects_sections,
       COUNT(DISTINCT project_id)::BIGINT AS number_of_projects
FROM task_projects_base GROUP BY task_id

- name: int_asana__task_projects
      description: Task-project relationships with aggregated project IDs, names, and sections
      grain: One row per task_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - staging.stg_asana__task_section
      - staging.stg_asana__section
      business_logic: 'Build task-project relationships and aggregates: - Start from staging.stg_asana__project_task (project_task). - Left join staging.stg_asana__project (project) on project_id after casting project_task.project_id to VARCHAR to match project.project_id; retain rows when the project is missing. - Left join staging.stg_asana__task_section (task_section) on task_id after casting both sides to VARCHAR; this can multiply project rows for tasks with multiple sections. - Left join staging.stg_asana__section (section) on section_id after casting task_section.section_id to VARCHAR; set section_name to "(no section)" when missing. - Produce task_projects_base with task_id, project_id, project_name, section_name. - Aggregate by task_id to form the output: - project_ids: concatenate all non-NULL project_id values using ", ", ordered ascending by project_id; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL values the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - project_names: concatenate all non-NULL project_name values using ", ", ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL values the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - projects_sections: for each row, create "project_name (section_name)" using "(no section)" when section is missing; exclude rows where project_name is NULL; concatenate using ", ", ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates are kept; if there are no non-NULL pairs the result is NULL; casing and whitespace are preserved. - number_of_projects: count distinct project_id values per task_id; NULL project_id is excluded; duplicates caused by multiple sections do not increase the count. - Output includes only task_ids present in project_task.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique task identifier; exactly one output row per task_id
      - name: project_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated project_id values ordered ascending by project_id; duplicates kept; NULL project_id excluded; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: project_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated project_name values ordered ascending by project_name; duplicates kept; NULL names excluded; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: projects_sections
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma + space separated 'project_name (section_name)' pairs ordered ascending by project_name; section_name uses '(no section)' when missing; pairs with NULL project_name excluded; duplicates kept; if none → NULL; casing/whitespace preserved
      - name: number_of_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of project_id per task_id; NULL project_id excluded; duplicates from multiple sections do not increase the count

WITH monthly AS (
 SELECT t.assignee_user_id AS user_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',t.created_at) AS activity_month,COUNT(*)::BIGINT total_tasks_assigned,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t.is_completed)::BIGINT tasks_completed,
 ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t.is_completed)/COUNT(*),2) completion_rate_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t.is_completed AND p.performance_grade IN ('excellent','good'))/NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t.is_completed),0),2) quality_rate_pct,
 AVG(p.days_open) FILTER(WHERE t.is_completed) avg_completion_time,AVG(p.health_score) avg_health_score,SUM(p.complexity_score) total_complexity_points
 FROM staging.stg_asana__task t JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics p ON t.task_id=p.task_id
 WHERE t.created_at>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '24 months' AND t.assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2
), w AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(total_tasks_assigned) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) prev_month_tasks,
 LAG(completion_rate_pct) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) prev_month_completion_rate,
 LAG(avg_completion_time) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) prev_month_avg_time,
 LAG(avg_health_score) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) prev_month_health_score,
 AVG(completion_rate_pct) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) completion_rate_3m_avg,
 AVG(avg_completion_time) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) completion_time_3m_avg,
 AVG(avg_health_score) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) health_score_3m_avg,
 SUM(total_tasks_assigned) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) cumulative_tasks_assigned,
 SUM(tasks_completed) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY activity_month) cumulative_tasks_completed
 FROM monthly
), trends AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND(100.0*(total_tasks_assigned-prev_month_tasks)/NULLIF(prev_month_tasks,0),2) task_volume_change_pct,
 ROUND(completion_rate_pct-prev_month_completion_rate,2) completion_rate_change_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*(avg_completion_time-prev_month_avg_time)/NULLIF(prev_month_avg_time,0),2) completion_time_change_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*(avg_health_score-prev_month_health_score)/NULLIF(prev_month_health_score,0),2) health_score_change_pct,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_pct>completion_rate_3m_avg+5 THEN 'improving' WHEN completion_rate_pct<completion_rate_3m_avg-5 THEN 'declining' ELSE 'stable' END completion_trend,
 CASE WHEN avg_completion_time<completion_time_3m_avg*.9 THEN 'faster' WHEN avg_completion_time>completion_time_3m_avg*1.1 THEN 'slower' ELSE 'stable' END speed_trend,
 RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY activity_month ORDER BY completion_rate_pct DESC) completion_rate_rank,
 RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY activity_month ORDER BY avg_health_score DESC) health_score_rank,
 RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY activity_month ORDER BY total_complexity_points DESC) workload_rank,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_pct>=90 AND avg_health_score>=80 THEN 'high_performer' WHEN completion_rate_pct>=75 AND avg_health_score>=65 THEN 'solid_performer' WHEN completion_rate_pct>=60 AND avg_health_score>=50 THEN 'developing_performer' WHEN completion_rate_pct>=40 THEN 'needs_support' ELSE 'at_risk' END productivity_tier
 FROM w
), final AS (
 SELECT *,TRUE is_valid_record,CASE WHEN task_volume_change_pct>200 THEN 'volume_spike' WHEN task_volume_change_pct< -80 THEN 'volume_drop' WHEN completion_rate_change_pct>50 THEN 'completion_spike' WHEN completion_rate_change_pct< -50 THEN 'completion_drop' WHEN completion_time_change_pct>100 THEN 'significant_slowdown' WHEN completion_time_change_pct< -50 THEN 'significant_speedup' ELSE 'normal' END anomaly_flag FROM trends
)
SELECT user_id,activity_month,total_tasks_assigned,tasks_completed,completion_rate_pct,COALESCE(quality_rate_pct,0) quality_rate_pct,avg_completion_time,avg_health_score,total_complexity_points,prev_month_tasks,prev_month_completion_rate,prev_month_avg_time,prev_month_health_score,completion_rate_3m_avg,completion_time_3m_avg,health_score_3m_avg,cumulative_tasks_assigned,cumulative_tasks_completed,task_volume_change_pct,completion_rate_change_pct,completion_time_change_pct,health_score_change_pct,completion_trend,speed_trend,completion_rate_rank,health_score_rank,workload_rank,productivity_tier,is_valid_record,anomaly_flag
FROM final WHERE activity_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL '11 months') ORDER BY user_id,activity_month DESC

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_asana__user_productivity_trends
      description: Monthly user productivity trends from Asana tasks with 3-month windows, MoM deltas, rankings, validation, and anomaly flags; valid rows only for the last 12 months
      grain: One row per user_id per activity_month (created_at month bucket) for months with at least one assigned task
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Scope and filters: - Use tasks where created_at and assignee_user_id are present. - Inner join to task performance metrics on task_id; tasks without metrics are excluded. - Aggregate only tasks created in the last 24 months; windows and cumulatives use this 24‑month history. - Monthly aggregation (per assignee and month of created_at): - total_tasks_assigned: count of tasks. - tasks_completed: count where the task is marked completed. - completion_rate_pct: tasks_completed divided by total_tasks_assigned, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 2 decimals; if no tasks, set to 0. - quality_rate_pct: number of tasks graded excellent or good divided by tasks_completed, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 2 decimals; if no completed tasks, set to 0. - avg_completion_time: average days_open over completed tasks only; null if none; not rounded. - avg_health_score: average health_score over all tasks in the month; not rounded. - total_complexity_points: sum of complexity_score. - Intra-user trends (ordered by activity_month ascending within user): - prev_month_*: prior month’s values for total_tasks_assigned, completion_rate_pct, avg_completion_time, avg_health_score (lag by 1 observed month). - 3‑month moving averages are row‑based (current plus up to two prior observed months) with no rounding; averages ignore nulls and return null if all inputs are null. - cumulative_*: running totals of total_tasks_assigned and tasks_completed from the start of the 24‑month window. - Month‑over‑month change metrics: - task_volume_change_pct: percent change from prev_month_tasks, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous is null or zero. - completion_rate_change_pct: difference from previous completion rate in percentage points, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous is null. - completion_time_change_pct: percent change from previous avg_completion_time, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous is null or zero. - health_score_change_pct: percent change from previous avg_health_score, rounded to 2 decimals; null if previous is null or zero. - Trend classification: - completion_trend: improving if current exceeds the 3‑month average by more than 5 points; declining if below it by more than 5; otherwise stable. - speed_trend: faster if current completion time is under 90% of its 3‑month average; slower if above 110%; otherwise stable; null comparisons result in stable. - Cross-user rankings (per activity_month): - completion_rate_rank by completion_rate_pct (descending), health_score_rank by avg_health_score (descending), workload_rank by total_complexity_points (descending). - Ranks use standard ranking with ties and gaps; 1 is best. Ranks are computed before validation, so filtered rows do not change rank values. - Productivity tiering: - high_performer if completion rate ≥90% and health score ≥80; solid_performer if ≥75% and ≥65; developing_performer if ≥60% and ≥50; needs_support if completion rate ≥40%; otherwise at_risk. - Data validation and anomalies: - is_valid_record is true unless any: missing keys; negative task counts or completion time; completion or quality rates outside 0–100%; health score outside 0–100. - anomaly_flag thresholds: volume_spike (>200%), volume_drop (<−80%), completion_spike (>50 pp), completion_drop (<−50 pp), significant_slowdown (>100%), significant_speedup (<−50%); otherwise normal. - Final output: - Keep only rows with is_valid_record = true and activity_month within the last 12 months; earlier months within the 24‑month window may still feed lags, moving averages, and cumulative metrics. - Order by user_id and activity_month descending (ordering does not affect stored content).'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Assignee user identifier; non-null; grouping key (one row per user_id and activity_month)
      - name: activity_month
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Month bucket of task created_at; output limited to last 12 months; timezone preserved
      - name: total_tasks_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of tasks assigned to the user created in the month within the 24‑month computation window
      - name: tasks_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of assigned tasks in the month that are completed
      - name: completion_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of assigned tasks completed, expressed as a percent rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no tasks; validated to 0–100
      - name: quality_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Number of tasks graded excellent or good divided by completed tasks, as a percent rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no completed tasks; validated to 0–100
      - name: avg_completion_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days_open for completed tasks in the month; null if none; not rounded
      - name: avg_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average health_score across assigned tasks in the month; not rounded; validated to 0–100
      - name: total_complexity_points
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of complexity_score across assigned tasks in the month
      - name: prev_month_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Prior observed month’s total_tasks_assigned for the same user; null if none
      - name: prev_month_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Prior observed month’s completion_rate_pct; null if none
      - name: prev_month_avg_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Prior observed month’s avg_completion_time; null if none
      - name: prev_month_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Prior observed month’s avg_health_score; null if none
      - name: completion_rate_3m_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of completion_rate_pct over current and up to two prior months; ignores nulls; not rounded
      - name: completion_time_3m_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of avg_completion_time over current and up to two prior months; ignores nulls; not rounded
      - name: health_score_3m_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average of avg_health_score over current and up to two prior months; ignores nulls; not rounded
      - name: cumulative_tasks_assigned
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of total_tasks_assigned per user ordered by activity_month within the 24‑month window
      - name: cumulative_tasks_completed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Running total of tasks_completed per user ordered by activity_month within the 24‑month window
      - name: task_volume_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month percent change vs prev_month_tasks, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous is null or zero
      - name: completion_rate_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month change in completion rate in percentage points, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous is null
      - name: completion_time_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month percent change of avg_completion_time, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous is null or zero
      - name: health_score_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Month-over-month percent change of avg_health_score, rounded to 2 decimals; null when previous is null or zero
      - name: completion_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend vs 3‑month average: improving if > avg+5, declining if < avg−5, else stable'
      - name: speed_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Completion speed trend: faster if < 90% of 3‑month average, slower if > 110%, else stable; nulls yield stable'
      - name: completion_rate_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank across users in the same activity_month by completion_rate_pct descending; ties share rank with gaps; 1 is best
      - name: health_score_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank across users in the same activity_month by avg_health_score descending; ties share rank with gaps; 1 is best
      - name: workload_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank across users in the same activity_month by total_complexity_points descending; ties share rank with gaps; 1 is best
      - name: productivity_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier: high_performer (≥90% and ≥80), solid_performer (≥75% and ≥65), developing_performer (≥60% and ≥50), needs_support (≥40%), else at_risk'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if record passes validation on keys, counts, times, and rate bounds; only true rows are output
      - name: anomaly_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Anomaly label: volume_spike, volume_drop, completion_spike, completion_drop, significant_slowdown, significant_speedup, else normal'

WITH creations AS (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date_day,
           COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS tasks_created
    FROM staging.stg_asana__task
    GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE)
),
completions AS (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(completed_at AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date_day,
           COUNT(*)::HUGEINT AS tasks_completed
    FROM staging.stg_asana__task
    WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(completed_at AS DATE)
),
days AS (
    SELECT date_day FROM creations
    UNION
    SELECT date_day FROM completions
)
SELECT d.date_day,
       COALESCE(c.tasks_created, 0)::HUGEINT AS tasks_created,
       COALESCE(x.tasks_completed, 0)::HUGEINT AS tasks_completed,
       (COALESCE(c.tasks_created, 0) - COALESCE(x.tasks_completed, 0))::HUGEINT AS net_task_change
FROM days d
LEFT JOIN creations c ON d.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.date_day
LEFT JOIN completions x ON d.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM x.date_day
ORDER BY d.date_day

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__daily_metrics
      description: Daily counts of tasks created, tasks completed, and their net difference, aggregated by calendar day.
      grain: One row per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task (created_at, completed_at)
      business_logic: 'Build two daily aggregates from staging.stg_asana__task: - Creations: for each task, take the calendar day of its creation timestamp; tasks missing a creation timestamp are counted under a single NULL day; count tasks per day and label as task_created. - Completions: for each task with a completion timestamp, take the calendar day of that timestamp; count tasks per day and label as task_completed. Combine both sets without deduplication, then for each day: - tasks_created = total counts from task_created entries for that day (else 0). - tasks_completed = total counts from task_completed entries for that day (else 0). - net_task_change = tasks_created minus tasks_completed. Output one row per day present in either set (including a NULL day if any tasks lack a creation timestamp), ordered ascending by date_day.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Calendar day used for aggregation (midnight in its time zone); may be NULL only from missing created_at; one row per distinct value.
      - name: tasks_created
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of tasks whose creation timestamp falls on date_day; 0 if none; never NULL.
      - name: tasks_completed
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of tasks with a completion timestamp that falls on date_day; 0 if none; never NULL.
      - name: net_task_change
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: tasks_created minus tasks_completed for the same date_day; can be negative; never NULL.

WITH base AS (
 SELECT p.project_id,p.project_name,p.team_id,t.team_name,p.owner_user_id project_owner,p.current_status project_status,p.created_at project_start_date,p.due_date project_deadline,
 h.total_tasks,h.completed_tasks,h.active_tasks,h.overdue_tasks,h.unique_assignees,h.completion_percentage,h.quality_percentage,h.risk_percentage,h.overall_health_score,h.health_grade,h.risk_level,h.project_forecast,h.focus_areas,
 DATE_DIFF('day',p.created_at::DATE,p.due_date::DATE)::BIGINT planned_duration_days,DATE_DIFF('day',p.created_at::DATE,CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT elapsed_days,DATE_DIFF('day',CURRENT_DATE,p.due_date::DATE)::BIGINT remaining_days
 FROM staging.stg_asana__project p LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__team t ON p.team_id::VARCHAR=t.team_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators h ON p.project_id=h.project_id
 WHERE p.project_name IS NOT NULL
), derived AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND(completion_percentage/NULLIF(elapsed_days,0),4) completion_rate_per_day,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks>0 AND unique_assignees IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(total_tasks::DOUBLE/GREATEST(1,unique_assignees),2) WHEN total_tasks>0 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END avg_tasks_per_assignee,
 CASE WHEN unique_assignees=0 THEN 'no_team' WHEN unique_assignees=1 THEN 'solo_project' WHEN unique_assignees<=3 THEN 'small_team' WHEN unique_assignees<=7 THEN 'medium_team' WHEN unique_assignees<=15 THEN 'large_team' ELSE 'enterprise_team' END team_size_category,
 CASE WHEN total_tasks<=5 THEN 'micro_project' WHEN total_tasks<=20 THEN 'small_project' WHEN total_tasks<=50 THEN 'medium_project' WHEN total_tasks<=100 THEN 'large_project' ELSE 'enterprise_project' END project_size_category
 FROM base
), scored AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>0 AND completion_percentage<100 THEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day) END estimated_days_to_completion,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>0 AND completion_percentage<100 THEN CASE WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days THEN 'on_schedule' WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days*1.2 THEN 'slight_delay' WHEN CEIL((100-completion_percentage)/completion_rate_per_day)<=remaining_days*1.5 THEN 'moderate_delay' ELSE 'significant_delay' END WHEN completion_percentage=100 THEN 'completed' WHEN remaining_days<0 THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'uncertain' END schedule_forecast,
 CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=2 THEN 25 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=1 THEN 20 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=.5 THEN 15 WHEN completion_rate_per_day>=.2 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END efficiency_score,
 CASE WHEN completion_percentage=100 THEN 25 WHEN remaining_days<0 THEN 5 ELSE 12 END time_management_score,
 CASE WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND unique_assignees>=2 THEN 25 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 2 AND 12 THEN 20 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 1 AND 15 THEN 15 WHEN unique_assignees>=1 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END collaboration_score,
 CASE project_size_category WHEN 'enterprise_project' THEN 1.2 WHEN 'large_project' THEN 1.1 WHEN 'medium_project' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'small_project' THEN .9 ELSE .8 END::DECIMAL(2,1) complexity_factor
 FROM derived
), totals AS (
 SELECT *,ROUND((overall_health_score*.4+efficiency_score*.25+time_management_score*.2+collaboration_score*.15)*complexity_factor,2)::DECIMAL(18,2) comprehensive_project_score,
 CASE WHEN unique_assignees>0 AND elapsed_days>0 THEN ROUND((completion_percentage*quality_percentage/100.0)/(unique_assignees*elapsed_days/30.0),3) ELSE 0 END roi_efficiency_ratio,
 CASE WHEN elapsed_days<=7 THEN 'startup_phase' WHEN elapsed_days<=30 THEN 'early_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=90 THEN 'active_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=180 THEN 'mature_development' WHEN elapsed_days<=365 THEN 'long_term_project' ELSE 'legacy_project' END project_maturity_phase
 FROM scored
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *,concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN overall_health_score>=80 THEN 'high_health' END,CASE WHEN completion_percentage>=75 THEN 'strong_progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_percentage>=70 THEN 'quality_delivery' END,CASE WHEN risk_percentage<=15 THEN 'low_risk' END,CASE WHEN unique_assignees>=3 THEN 'good_collaboration' END,CASE WHEN schedule_forecast IN ('on_schedule','completed') THEN 'on_time' END) success_factors,
 concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN overall_health_score<60 THEN 'improve_health' END,CASE WHEN completion_percentage<50 AND elapsed_days>30 THEN 'accelerate_progress' END,CASE WHEN quality_percentage<60 THEN 'enhance_quality' END,CASE WHEN risk_percentage>25 THEN 'reduce_risks' END,CASE WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee>10 THEN 'balance_workload' END,CASE WHEN schedule_forecast IN ('moderate_delay','significant_delay') THEN 'address_delays' END,CASE WHEN unique_assignees<2 AND total_tasks>10 THEN 'expand_team' END) improvement_opportunities,
 CASE WHEN risk_level='high_risk' OR schedule_forecast='overdue' THEN 'immediate_attention' WHEN overall_health_score<50 OR schedule_forecast='significant_delay' THEN 'high_priority' WHEN overall_health_score>=80 AND schedule_forecast='on_schedule' THEN 'monitor' ELSE 'regular_review' END management_priority
 FROM totals
), final AS (SELECT *,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY comprehensive_project_score DESC) overall_performance_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY overall_health_score DESC) health_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY completion_percentage DESC) progress_rank,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY roi_efficiency_ratio DESC) efficiency_rank,
 (project_id IS NOT NULL AND project_name IS NOT NULL AND comprehensive_project_score BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND completion_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND quality_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND risk_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks>=0 AND completed_tasks<=total_tasks) is_valid_record FROM ranked)
SELECT * FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY comprehensive_project_score DESC,overall_health_score DESC,project_id
