blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__project_analytics
      description: Executive-level Asana project analytics with health, workload, schedule, scoring, ROI, maturity, priorities, and ranks; only valid projects are output
      grain: One row per project_id (valid records only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      business_logic: 'Build analytics in stages: - Filter projects to those with a non-null project_name. - Join team details by team_id and health indicators by project_id. - Derive schedule metrics: - planned_duration_days: whole days from start (created_at) to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - elapsed_days: whole days from start to today. - remaining_days: whole days from today to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - completion_rate_per_day: completion_percentage divided by elapsed_days, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive. - Resource/workload metrics: - avg_tasks_per_assignee: if total_tasks > 0, divide total_tasks by max(1, unique_assignees) and round to 2 decimals; if unique_assignees is null in this case, the result is null; otherwise 0. - team_size_category by unique_assignees: 0 → no_team; 1 → solo_project; 2–3 → small_team; 4–7 → medium_team; 8–15 → large_team; else enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team). - project_size_category by total_tasks: 0–5 → micro_project; 6–20 → small_project; 21–50 → medium_project; 51–100 → large_project; else enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project). - estimated_days_to_completion: when completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, (100 − completion_percentage) divided by completion_rate_per_day, rounded up to whole days; otherwise null. - schedule_forecast: if completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, compare estimated_days_to_completion to remaining_days: ≤ remaining_days → on_schedule; ≤ remaining_days × 1.2 → slight_delay; ≤ remaining_days × 1.5 → moderate_delay; else significant_delay. Otherwise, if completion_percentage = 100 → completed; else if remaining_days < 0 → overdue; else uncertain. - Performance scoring: - efficiency_score (0–25): by completion_rate_per_day thresholds, inclusive bands: ≥2.0 → 25; ≥1.0 → 20; ≥0.5 → 15; ≥0.2 → 10; else 5; then constrained to 0–25. - time_management_score (0–25): by schedule_forecast mapping: on_schedule 25; slight_delay 20; moderate_delay 15; significant_delay 10; overdue 5; else 12; constrained to 0–25. - collaboration_score (0–25): by avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size: if avg between 3 and 8 (inclusive) and unique_assignees ≥ 2 → 25; if avg between 2 and 12 → 20; if avg between 1 and 15 → 15; if unique_assignees ≥ 1 → 10; else 5; constrained to 0–25. - complexity_factor: enterprise_project 1.2; large_project 1.1; medium_project 1.0; small_project 0.9; micro_project 0.8. - Final analytics: - comprehensive_project_score: weighted sum of health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%), multiplied by complexity_factor and rounded to 2 decimals. - roi_efficiency_ratio: if unique_assignees > 0 and elapsed_days > 0, compute (completion_percentage × quality_percentage ÷ 100) divided by (unique_assignees × elapsed_days ÷ 30), rounded to 3 decimals; otherwise 0. - project_maturity_phase by elapsed_days: ≤7 → startup_phase; ≤30 → early_development; ≤90 → active_development; ≤180 → mature_development; ≤365 → long_term_project; else legacy_project (null maps to legacy_project). - success_factors: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": high_health (overall_health_score ≥ 80), strong_progress (completion_percentage ≥ 75), quality_delivery (quality_percentage ≥ 70), low_risk (risk_percentage ≤ 15), good_collaboration (unique_assignees ≥ 3), on_time (schedule_forecast is on_schedule or completed); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - improvement_opportunities: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": improve_health (overall_health_score < 60), accelerate_progress (completion_percentage < 50 and elapsed_days > 30), enhance_quality (quality_percentage < 60), reduce_risks (risk_percentage > 25), balance_workload (avg_tasks_per_assignee > 10), address_delays (schedule_forecast is moderate_delay or significant_delay), expand_team (unique_assignees < 2 and total_tasks > 10); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - management_priority: immediate_attention if risk_level is high_risk or schedule_forecast is overdue; else high_priority if overall_health_score < 50 or schedule_forecast is significant_delay; else monitor if overall_health_score ≥ 80 and schedule_forecast is on_schedule; otherwise regular_review. - Validation and ranking: - is_valid_record is true only when: project_id and project_name are present; comprehensive_project_score is between 0 and 120 inclusive; completion_percentage, quality_percentage, and risk_percentage are each between 0 and 100 inclusive; total_tasks and completed_tasks are not negative; and completed_tasks does not exceed total_tasks. - Ranks are computed across all rows before filtering: overall_performance_rank by comprehensive_project_score descending; health_rank by overall_health_score descending; progress_rank by completion_percentage descending; efficiency_rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending. Ties share the same rank with gaps. - Output: return only rows where is_valid_record is true, ordered by comprehensive_project_score descending, then overall_health_score descending, then project_id ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from Asana; grouping key with at most one output row per project_id
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source; rows with null project_name are excluded
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team identifier associated with the project; null if no matching team
      - name: team_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team name joined by team_id; null if no match
      - name: project_owner
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user identifier from the project record (no user lookup applied)
      - name: project_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current project status from the source (passthrough)
      - name: project_start_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project start timestamp from created_at
      - name: project_deadline
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project due date timestamp; may be null
      - name: total_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total task count from health indicators; must be nonnegative for validity
      - name: completed_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Completed task count from health indicators; must be between 0 and total_tasks
      - name: active_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active or in-progress task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: overdue_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Past-due, incomplete task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct assignee count from health indicators; 0 means no assignees; may be null
      - name: completion_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of tasks completed from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: quality_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent meeting quality criteria from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent flagged as risky from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall health score from health indicators used in composite scoring
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Health grade label from health indicators
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Risk level label from health indicators (e.g., high_risk)
      - name: project_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Forecast label from health indicators, distinct from schedule_forecast
      - name: focus_areas
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Focus areas text from health indicators
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from start to deadline; null if no deadline
      - name: elapsed_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days since start; null if start date is null
      - name: remaining_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days until deadline; negative if overdue; null if no deadline
      - name: completion_rate_per_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion percentage per day since start, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive
      - name: avg_tasks_per_assignee
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_tasks > 0, total_tasks divided by max(1, unique_assignees) rounded to 2 decimals (null if unique_assignees is null); otherwise 0
      - name: team_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Team size bucket by unique_assignees: no_team, solo_project, small_team, medium_team, large_team, or enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team)'
      - name: project_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Project size bucket by total_tasks: micro_project, small_project, medium_project, large_project, or enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project)'
      - name: estimated_days_to_completion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining percent divided by daily completion rate and rounded up when rate > 0 and completion < 100; otherwise null
      - name: schedule_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlook: on_schedule, slight_delay, moderate_delay, significant_delay, completed, overdue, or uncertain based on thresholds and gating rules'
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from completion_rate_per_day thresholds, constrained to 0–25
      - name: time_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from schedule_forecast mapping, constrained to 0–25
      - name: collaboration_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size, constrained to 0–25
      - name: complexity_factor
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: 'Multiplier by project_size_category: micro 0.8, small 0.9, medium 1.0, large 1.1, enterprise 1.2'

specification.name: asana__project_analytics
specification.description: Executive-level Asana project analytics with health, workload, schedule, scoring, ROI, maturity, priorities, and ranks; only valid projects are output
specification.grain: One row per project_id (valid records only)
specification.business_logic: Build analytics in stages: - Filter projects to those with a non-null project_name. - Join team details by team_id and health indicators by project_id. - Derive schedule metrics: - planned_duration_days: whole days from start (created_at) to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - elapsed_days: whole days from start to today. - remaining_days: whole days from today to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - completion_rate_per_day: completion_percentage divided by elapsed_days, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive. - Resource/workload metrics: - avg_tasks_per_assignee: if total_tasks > 0, divide total_tasks by max(1, unique_assignees) and round to 2 decimals; if unique_assignees is null in this case, the result is null; otherwise 0. - team_size_category by unique_assignees: 0 → no_team; 1 → solo_project; 2–3 → small_team; 4–7 → medium_team; 8–15 → large_team; else enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team). - project_size_category by total_tasks: 0–5 → micro_project; 6–20 → small_project; 21–50 → medium_project; 51–100 → large_project; else enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project). - estimated_days_to_completion: when completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, (100 − completion_percentage) divided by completion_rate_per_day, rounded up to whole days; otherwise null. - schedule_forecast: if completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, compare estimated_days_to_completion to remaining_days: ≤ remaining_days → on_schedule; ≤ remaining_days × 1.2 → slight_delay; ≤ remaining_days × 1.5 → moderate_delay; else significant_delay. Otherwise, if completion_percentage = 100 → completed; else if remaining_days < 0 → overdue; else uncertain. - Performance scoring: - efficiency_score (0–25): by completion_rate_per_day thresholds, inclusive bands: ≥2.0 → 25; ≥1.0 → 20; ≥0.5 → 15; ≥0.2 → 10; else 5; then constrained to 0–25. - time_management_score (0–25): by schedule_forecast mapping: on_schedule 25; slight_delay 20; moderate_delay 15; significant_delay 10; overdue 5; else 12; constrained to 0–25. - collaboration_score (0–25): by avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size: if avg between 3 and 8 (inclusive) and unique_assignees ≥ 2 → 25; if avg between 2 and 12 → 20; if avg between 1 and 15 → 15; if unique_assignees ≥ 1 → 10; else 5; constrained to 0–25. - complexity_factor: enterprise_project 1.2; large_project 1.1; medium_project 1.0; small_project 0.9; micro_project 0.8. - Final analytics: - comprehensive_project_score: weighted sum of health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%), multiplied by complexity_factor and rounded to 2 decimals. - roi_efficiency_ratio: if unique_assignees > 0 and elapsed_days > 0, compute (completion_percentage × quality_percentage ÷ 100) divided by (unique_assignees × elapsed_days ÷ 30), rounded to 3 decimals; otherwise 0. - project_maturity_phase by elapsed_days: ≤7 → startup_phase; ≤30 → early_development; ≤90 → active_development; ≤180 → mature_development; ≤365 → long_term_project; else legacy_project (null maps to legacy_project). - success_factors: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": high_health (overall_health_score ≥ 80), strong_progress (completion_percentage ≥ 75), quality_delivery (quality_percentage ≥ 70), low_risk (risk_percentage ≤ 15), good_collaboration (unique_assignees ≥ 3), on_time (schedule_forecast is on_schedule or completed); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - improvement_opportunities: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": improve_health (overall_health_score < 60), accelerate_progress (completion_percentage < 50 and elapsed_days > 30), enhance_quality (quality_percentage < 60), reduce_risks (risk_percentage > 25), balance_workload (avg_tasks_per_assignee > 10), address_delays (schedule_forecast is moderate_delay or significant_delay), expand_team (unique_assignees < 2 and total_tasks > 10); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - management_priority: immediate_attention if risk_level is high_risk or schedule_forecast is overdue; else high_priority if overall_health_score < 50 or schedule_forecast is significant_delay; else monitor if overall_health_score ≥ 80 and schedule_forecast is on_schedule; otherwise regular_review. - Validation and ranking: - is_valid_record is true only when: project_id and project_name are present; comprehensive_project_score is between 0 and 120 inclusive; completion_percentage, quality_percentage, and risk_percentage are each between 0 and 100 inclusive; total_tasks and completed_tasks are not negative; and completed_tasks does not exceed total_tasks. - Ranks are computed across all rows before filtering: overall_performance_rank by comprehensive_project_score descending; health_rank by overall_health_score descending; progress_rank by completion_percentage descending; efficiency_rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending. Ties share the same rank with gaps. - Output: return only rows where is_valid_record is true, ordered by comprehensive_project_score descending, then overall_health_score descending, then project_id ascending.

agent_sql.raw_text:
WITH story_agg AS (SELECT target_task_id,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='created') creation_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') first_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='assigned') last_assignment_timestamp,MAX(created_at) last_modification_timestamp,MIN(created_at) FILTER(WHERE action_taken='completed') completion_timestamp,COUNT(*)::BIGINT total_story_events,COUNT(DISTINCT action_taken)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COUNT(DISTINCT created_at::DATE)::BIGINT days_with_activity FROM intermediate.int_asana__task_story WHERE action_taken IS NOT NULL GROUP BY target_task_id),
base AS (SELECT t.*,m.task_status_category,m.performance_grade,m.health_score,m.response_time_days,m.delay_days,m.complexity_score,m.urgency_score,m.activity_score,s.creation_timestamp,s.first_assignment_timestamp,s.last_assignment_timestamp,s.last_modification_timestamp,s.completion_timestamp,COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::BIGINT total_story_events,COALESCE(s.unique_action_types,0)::BIGINT unique_action_types,COALESCE(s.days_with_activity,0)::BIGINT days_with_activity,
 DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,s.first_assignment_timestamp)::BIGINT hours_to_assignment,DATE_DIFF('hour',s.first_assignment_timestamp,t.completed_at)::BIGINT hours_assigned_to_completion,DATE_DIFF('hour',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))::BIGINT total_lifecycle_hours,
 CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))>0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE/DATE_DIFF('day',t.created_at,COALESCE(t.completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),2) ELSE COALESCE(s.total_story_events,0)::DOUBLE END avg_daily_activity_rate
FROM staging.stg_asana__task t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics m ON t.task_id=m.task_id LEFT JOIN story_agg s ON t.task_id=s.target_task_id WHERE t.created_at IS NOT NULL),
calc AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN is_completed THEN CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment<=24 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'highly_efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=72 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=336 THEN 'efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=168 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=720 THEN 'moderate' WHEN hours_to_assignment<=336 THEN 'slow_start' WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>720 THEN 'slow_completion' ELSE 'inefficient' END WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>168 THEN 'stalled_unassigned' WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'stalled_assigned' WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND total_lifecycle_hours>72 THEN 'urgent_delayed' ELSE 'in_progress' END lifecycle_efficiency_category,
CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=2 THEN 'very_active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 THEN 'active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.5 THEN 'moderate_activity' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=.1 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'dormant' END activity_level,
LEAST(100,GREATEST(0,(CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 40 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=2 THEN 30 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN is_completed THEN 10 WHEN due_date::DATE>CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN due_date::DATE=CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END)+(CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 THEN 30 WHEN response_time_days<=3 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days<=7 THEN 20 WHEN response_time_days<=14 THEN 15 WHEN response_time_days IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END)+COALESCE(activity_score,1)*4+(CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=168 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=336 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=720 THEN 10 WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END)))::INTEGER lifecycle_health_score,
CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(first_assignment_timestamp,created_at)>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '1 day' THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL AND modified_at>=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '7 day' THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days>0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END current_lifecycle_stage
FROM base), context AS (SELECT c.*,p.project_name,p.team_id,CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(h.overall_health_score,50) END::INTEGER project_health_score,u.user_name assignee_name,CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'unknown' END assignee_performance_grade
FROM calc c LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task pt ON c.task_id=pt.task_id::VARCHAR LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project p ON pt.project_id::VARCHAR=p.project_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators h ON p.project_id=h.project_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__user u ON c.assignee_user_id::VARCHAR=u.user_id),
final AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN project_health_score IS NULL THEN 'below_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>20 THEN 'above_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>10 THEN 'slightly_above_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-10 THEN 'project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score-project_health_score>=-20 THEN 'slightly_below_average' ELSE 'below_project_average' END relative_performance_vs_project,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>336 THEN 'delayed_assignment' END,CASE WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion>1440 THEN 'prolonged_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate<.1 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'dormant_task' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours>336 THEN 'overengineered_simple' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND response_time_days>3 THEN 'urgent_ignored' END,CASE WHEN parent_task_id IS NOT NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours>720 THEN 'blocked_subtask' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>14 THEN 'severely_delayed' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events>50 THEN 'high_churn' END) anomaly_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN lifecycle_efficiency_category='highly_efficient' THEN 'fast_track' END,CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days=0 AND performance_grade='excellent' THEN 'exemplary_execution' END,CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate>=1 AND is_completed THEN 'consistent_progress' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days<=1 AND hours_assigned_to_completion<=168 THEN 'rapid_delivery' END,CASE WHEN complexity_score=3 AND lifecycle_health_score>=80 THEN 'complex_mastery' END,CASE WHEN urgency_score>=4 AND delay_days=0 THEN 'urgent_success' END) success_patterns,
concat_ws(', ',CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment>72 THEN 'faster_assignment' END,CASE WHEN activity_level IN ('low_activity','dormant') THEN 'increase_engagement' END,CASE WHEN delay_days>0 THEN 'improve_time_management' END,CASE WHEN response_time_days>3 THEN 'enhance_responsiveness' END,CASE WHEN lifecycle_health_score<60 THEN 'overall_process_improvement' END,CASE WHEN total_story_events<3 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'add_progress_updates' END) improvement_opportunities,
CASE WHEN complexity_score=1 AND total_lifecycle_hours<=72 THEN 'appropriate_simple' WHEN complexity_score=2 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 73 AND 336 THEN 'appropriate_medium' WHEN complexity_score=3 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 337 AND 720 THEN 'appropriate_complex' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours<complexity_score*72 THEN 'faster_than_expected' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours>complexity_score*240 THEN 'slower_than_expected' ELSE 'within_range' END complexity_execution_match,
(task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_name IS NOT NULL AND lifecycle_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_lifecycle_hours>=0 AND (hours_to_assignment IS NULL OR hours_to_assignment>=0) AND (hours_assigned_to_completion IS NULL OR hours_assigned_to_completion>=0) AND avg_daily_activity_rate>=0 AND NOT(is_completed AND completion_timestamp IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)) is_valid_record
FROM context)
SELECT task_id,task_name,created_at,completed_at,due_date,is_completed,assignee_user_id,parent_task_id,task_status_category,performance_grade,health_score,response_time_days,delay_days,complexity_score,urgency_score,activity_score,creation_timestamp,first_assignment_timestamp,last_assignment_timestamp,last_modification_timestamp,completion_timestamp,hours_to_assignment,hours_assigned_to_completion,total_lifecycle_hours,total_story_events,unique_action_types,days_with_activity,avg_daily_activity_rate,lifecycle_efficiency_category,activity_level,lifecycle_health_score,current_lifecycle_stage,anomaly_patterns,success_patterns,improvement_opportunities,complexity_execution_match,project_name,team_id,project_health_score,assignee_name,assignee_performance_grade,relative_performance_vs_project,is_valid_record
FROM final WHERE is_valid_record ORDER BY lifecycle_health_score DESC,total_lifecycle_hours,task_id

hours_assigned_to_completion > 720 THEN 'slow_completion' ELSE 'inefficient' END WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 168 THEN 'stalled_unassigned' WHEN NOT hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 720 THEN 'stalled_assigned' WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND total_lifecycle_hours > 72 THEN 'urgent_delayed' ELSE 'in_progress' END AS lifecycle_efficiency_category, CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 2 THEN 'very_active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 1 THEN 'active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 0.5 THEN 'moderate_activity' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 0.1 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'dormant' END AS activity_level, CAST(LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, (CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 THEN 40 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days <= 2 THEN 30 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN is_completed THEN 10 WHEN CAST(due_date AS DATE) > CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN CAST(due_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END) + (CASE WHEN response_time_days <= 1 THEN 30 WHEN response_time_days <= 3 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN response_time_days <= 14 THEN 15 WHEN NOT response_time_days IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END) + COALESCE(activity_score, 1) * 4 + (CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 168 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score = 2 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 336 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 720 THEN 10 WHEN total_lifecycle_hours <= 72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END))) AS INT) AS lifecycle_health_score, CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(first_assignment_timestamp, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL AND modified_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days > 0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END AS current_lifecycle_stage FROM base

cte_definitions.name: context
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT c.*, p.project_name, p.team_id, CAST(CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(h.overall_health_score, 50) END AS INT) AS project_health_score, u.user_name AS assignee_name, CASE WHEN NOT u.user_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' END AS assignee_performance_grade FROM calc AS c LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project_task AS pt ON c.task_id = CAST(pt.task_id AS TEXT) LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__project AS p ON CAST(pt.project_id AS TEXT) = p.project_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators AS h ON p.project_id = h.project_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_asana__user AS u ON CAST(c.assignee_user_id AS TEXT) = u.user_id

cte_definitions.name: final
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN project_health_score IS NULL THEN 'below_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score > 20 THEN 'above_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score > 10 THEN 'slightly_above_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score >= -10 THEN 'project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score >= -20 THEN 'slightly_below_average' ELSE 'below_project_average' END AS relative_performance_vs_project, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment > 336 THEN 'delayed_assignment' END, CASE WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion > 1440 THEN 'prolonged_execution' END, CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate < 0.1 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'dormant_task' END, CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours > 336 THEN 'overengineered_simple' END, CASE WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND response_time_days > 3 THEN 'urgent_ignored' END, CASE WHEN NOT parent_task_id IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 720 THEN 'blocked_subtask' END, CASE WHEN delay_days > 14 THEN 'severely_delayed' END, CASE WHEN total_story_events > 50 THEN 'high_churn' END) AS anomaly_patterns, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN lifecycle_efficiency_category = 'highly_efficient' THEN 'fast_track' END, CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 AND performance_grade = 'excellent' THEN 'exemplary_execution' END, CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 1 AND is_completed THEN 'consistent_progress' END, CASE WHEN response_time_days <= 1 AND hours_assigned_to_completion <= 168 THEN 'rapid_delivery' END, CASE WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND lifecycle_health_score >= 80 THEN 'complex_mastery' END, CASE WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND delay_days = 0 THEN 'urgent_success' END) AS success_patterns, CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment > 72 THEN 'faster_assignment' END, CASE WHEN activity_level IN ('low_activity', 'dormant') THEN 'increase_engagement' END, CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN 'improve_time_management' END, CASE WHEN response_time_days > 3 THEN 'enhance_responsiveness' END, CASE WHEN lifecycle_health_score < 60 THEN 'overall_process_improvement' END, CASE WHEN total_story_events < 3 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'add_progress_updates' END) AS improvement_opportunities, CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 72 THEN 'appropriate_simple' WHEN complexity_score = 2 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 73 AND 336 THEN 'appropriate_medium' WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 337 AND 720 THEN 'appropriate_complex' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score * 72 THEN 'faster_than_expected' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score * 240 THEN 'slower_than_expected' ELSE 'within_range' END AS complexity_execution_match, (NOT task_id IS NULL AND NOT task_name IS NULL AND lifecycle_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND total_lifecycle_hours >= 0 AND (hours_to_assignment IS NULL OR hours_to_assignment >= 0) AND (hours_assigned_to_completion IS NULL OR hours_assigned_to_completion >= 0) AND avg_daily_activity_rate >= 0 AND NOT (is_completed AND completion_timestamp IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)) AS is_valid_record FROM context

- name: asana__task_lifecycle_analysis
      description: Deterministic lifecycle analytics per task with computed timings, classifications, pattern lists, and project/user context; outputs only records passing validation
      grain: One row per task_id per associated project (or one row if no project), after validation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      business_logic: '1) Base rows: include tasks from staging.stg_asana__task where created_at is not null. 2) Join per-task metrics from intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_status_category, performance_grade, health_score, response_time_days, delay_days, complexity_score, urgency_score, activity_score). 3) Build task stories from intermediate.int_asana__task_story where action_taken is not null and derive per task: - creation_timestamp: earliest ''created'' story, - first_assignment_timestamp: earliest ''assigned'' story, - last_assignment_timestamp: latest ''assigned'' story, - last_modification_timestamp: latest story across all actions, - completion_timestamp: earliest ''completed'' story, - Activity aggregates: total_story_events (count), unique_action_types (distinct action_taken), days_with_activity (distinct calendar dates of stories). 4) Compute lifecycle durations: - hours_to_assignment: hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp when first_assignment_timestamp exists; otherwise null, - hours_assigned_to_completion: hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at when both exist; otherwise null, - total_lifecycle_hours: hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at if completed, else to the current time, - avg_daily_activity_rate: if lifecycle days from task.created_at to task.completed_at or current time > 0, then total_story_events divided by that day count rounded to two decimals; otherwise equals total_story_events. 5) Classifications and scores: - lifecycle_efficiency_category: • If completed: ''highly_efficient'' when hours_to_assignment<=24 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''efficient'' when <=72 and <=336; ''moderate'' when <=168 and <=720; ''slow_start'' when hours_to_assignment<=336; ''slow_completion'' when hours_assigned_to_completion>720; else ''inefficient''. • If not completed: ''stalled_unassigned'' when hours_to_assignment is null and total_lifecycle_hours>168; ''stalled_assigned'' when hours_to_assignment is not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''urgent_delayed'' when urgency_score>=4 and total_lifecycle_hours>72; else ''in_progress''. - activity_level by avg_daily_activity_rate: >=2.0 ''very_active''; >=1.0 ''active''; >=0.5 ''moderate_activity''; >=0.1 ''low_activity''; else ''dormant''. - lifecycle_health_score: clamp to [0,100] the sum of: • Timeliness: completed on time=40; completed with delay_days<=2=30; <=7=20; completed late>7=10; if not completed and due_date>today=35; due today=25; overdue=5. • Response speed: response_time_days<=1=30; <=3=25; <=7=20; <=14=15; non-null else=10; null=5. • Activity: activity_score*4. • Complexity fit: complexity=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=168=10; complexity=2 and <=336=10; complexity=3 and <=720=10; any task <=72 hours=8; else=5. - current_lifecycle_stage: ''backlog'' (not completed and no assignee); ''newly_assigned'' (not completed, assignee exists, and within 1 day of first assignment or creation if assignment missing); ''active_development'' (not completed, assignee exists, and modified within 7 days); ''stagnant'' (not completed, assignee exists, and last modification >7 days); ''completed_on_time'' (completed with delay_days=0); ''completed_delayed'' (completed with delay_days>0); else ''unknown_state''. 6) Pattern lists (tokens evaluated in fixed order, joined by ", ", and trimmed; empty string if none): - anomaly_patterns: ''delayed_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>336; ''prolonged_execution'' if hours_assigned_to_completion>1440; ''dormant_task'' if avg_daily_activity_rate<0.1 and not completed; ''overengineered_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours>336; ''urgent_ignored'' if urgency_score>=4 and response_time_days>3; ''blocked_subtask'' if parent_task_id not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''severely_delayed'' if delay_days>14; ''high_churn'' if total_story_events>50. - success_patterns: ''fast_track'' if lifecycle_efficiency_category=''highly_efficient''; ''exemplary_execution'' if completed, on time, and performance_grade=''excellent''; ''consistent_progress'' if avg_daily_activity_rate>=1.0 and completed; ''rapid_delivery'' if response_time_days<=1 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''complex_mastery'' if complexity_score=3 and lifecycle_health_score>=80; ''urgent_success'' if urgency_score>=4 and delay_days=0. - improvement_opportunities: ''faster_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>72; ''increase_engagement'' if activity_level in (''low_activity'',''dormant''); ''improve_time_management'' if delay_days>0; ''enhance_responsiveness'' if response_time_days>3; ''overall_process_improvement'' if lifecycle_health_score<60; ''add_progress_updates'' if total_story_events<3 and not completed. - complexity_execution_match (first match wins): ''appropriate_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=72; ''appropriate_medium'' if complexity_score=2 and total_lifecycle_hours in 73–336; ''appropriate_complex'' if complexity_score=3 and total_lifecycle_hours in 337–720; ''faster_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score*72; ''slower_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score*240; else ''within_range''. 7) Project context: join staging.stg_asana__project_task on task_id, then staging.stg_asana__project left-joined to intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators to get project_name, team_id, and project_health_score (defaults to 50 when the project exists without indicators). Tasks with multiple projects yield one row per membership; tasks without a project retain a single row with null project fields. 8) User context: join staging.stg_asana__user by casting assignee_user_id to the user_id type to get assignee_name; assignee_performance_grade is always ''unknown'' for matched users. 9) Relative performance vs project: compare lifecycle_health_score to project_health_score and assign: >+20 ''above_project_average''; >+10 ''slightly_above_average''; >= -10 ''project_average''; >= -20 ''slightly_below_average''; else ''below_project_average'' (null project score falls into ''below_project_average''). 10) Data quality validation (is_valid_record): mark false when task_id or task_name is null; lifecycle_health_score outside [0,100]; any of total_lifecycle_hours, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, or avg_daily_activity_rate is negative; or is_completed=true while both completion_timestamp and completed_at are null. Only rows with is_valid_record=true are kept, and results are sorted by lifecycle_health_score descending, then total_lifecycle_hours ascending, then task_id.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asana task identifier; may repeat across rows if the task belongs to multiple projects
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task display name from stg_asana__task
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task creation timestamp from stg_asana__task; non-null by model filter
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task completion timestamp from stg_asana__task; null if not completed
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Due date from stg_asana__task; may be null and is compared to current date in scoring
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the task is marked completed in stg_asana__task
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current assignee user_id from stg_asana__task; may be null
      - name: parent_task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Parent task_id when this is a subtask; null otherwise
      - name: task_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status category from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; passed through as-is
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Performance grade from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; used in success_patterns
      - name: health_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Health score from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; not recomputed here
      - name: response_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to first response from metrics; used in scoring and patterns; null treated as worst in scoring
      - name: delay_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days completed past due date from metrics; used in scoring and patterns
      - name: complexity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Complexity score from metrics (integer); used in complexity matching and scoring
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Urgency score from metrics (integer); used in efficiency and patterns
      - name: activity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity score from metrics (integer); contributes to lifecycle_health_score as activity_score*4
      - name: creation_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'created' story timestamp; may be null
      - name: first_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_modification_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest story timestamp across all actions; null if no stories
      - name: completion_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'completed' story timestamp; required when is_completed and completed_at is null
      - name: hours_to_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: hours_assigned_to_completion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at; null if either timestamp is missing
      - name: total_lifecycle_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at, or to the current time if not completed
      - name: total_story_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all stories with non-null action_taken for the task
      - name: unique_action_types
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of action_taken values across stories for the task
      - name: days_with_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar dates with any story activity
      - name: avg_daily_activity_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average stories per day across the lifecycle; rounded to 2 decimals when lifecycle days > 0, else equals total_story_events
      - name: lifecycle_efficiency_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Efficiency class based on completion status, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, total_lifecycle_hours, and urgency_score using ordered rules
      - name: activity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Activity class from avg_daily_activity_rate thresholds: very_active, active, moderate_activity, low_activity, dormant'
      - name: lifecycle_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall lifecycle score clamped to [0,100] from timeliness, response speed, activity_score*4, and complexity adaptation
      - name: current_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage label from ordered rules: backlog, newly_assigned, active_development, stagnant, completed_on_time, completed_delayed, or unknown_state'
      - name: anomaly_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated anomaly tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: success_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated success tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: improvement_opportunities
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated improvement tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: complexity_execution_match
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Execution speed vs complexity classification with first-match priority: appropriate_simple/medium/complex, faster_than_expected, slower_than_expected, within_range'
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from stg_asana__project via project membership; null when no project
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team ID from the associated project; null when no project
      - name: project_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Project overall health score (default 50 when project exists but no indicator); null when no project membership
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user_name from stg_asana__user using the casted assignee_user_id join; null if no match
      - name: assignee_performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee performance grade from user context; set to 'unknown' for any matched user by design
      - name: relative_performance_vs_project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Relative class vs project_health_score: above_project_average, slightly_above_average, project_average, slightly_below_average, below_project_average (null project treated as below_project_average)'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if all data quality checks pass; the final result set filters to is_valid_record=true

columns.description: Current assignee user_id from stg_asana__task; may be null

columns.name: parent_task_id
columns.description: Parent task_id when this is a subtask; null otherwise

columns.name: task_status_category
columns.description: Status category from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; passed through as-is

columns.name: performance_grade
columns.description: Performance grade from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; used in success_patterns

columns.name: health_score
columns.description: Health score from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; not recomputed here

columns.name: response_time_days
columns.description: Days from creation to first response from metrics; used in scoring and patterns; null treated as worst in scoring

columns.name: delay_days
columns.description: Days completed past due date from metrics; used in scoring and patterns

columns.name: complexity_score
columns.description: Complexity score from metrics (integer); used in complexity matching and scoring

columns.name: urgency_score
columns.description: Urgency score from metrics (integer); used in efficiency and patterns

columns.name: activity_score
columns.description: Activity score from metrics (integer); contributes to lifecycle_health_score as activity_score*4

columns.name: creation_timestamp
columns.description: Earliest 'created' story timestamp; may be null

columns.name: first_assignment_timestamp
columns.description: Earliest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned

columns.name: last_assignment_timestamp
columns.description: Latest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned

columns.name: last_modification_timestamp
columns.description: Latest story timestamp across all actions; null if no stories

columns.name: completion_timestamp
columns.description: Earliest 'completed' story timestamp; required when is_completed and completed_at is null

columns.name: hours_to_assignment
columns.description: Hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp; null if never assigned

columns.name: hours_assigned_to_completion
columns.description: Hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at; null if either timestamp is missing

columns.name: total_lifecycle_hours
columns.description: Hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at, or to the current time if not completed

columns.name: total_story_events
columns.description: Count of all stories with non-null action_taken for the task

columns.name: unique_action_types
columns.description: Distinct count of action_taken values across stories for the task

columns.name: days_with_activity
columns.description: Distinct count of calendar dates with any story activity

columns.name: avg_daily_activity_rate
columns.description: Average stories per day across the lifecycle; rounded to 2 decimals when lifecycle days > 0, else equals total_story_events

columns.name: lifecycle_efficiency_category
columns.description: Efficiency class based on completion status, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, total_lifecycle_hours, and urgency_score using ordered rules

columns.name: activity_level
columns.description: Activity class from avg_daily_activity_rate thresholds: very_active, active, moderate_activity, low_activity, dormant

columns.name: lifecycle_health_score
columns.description: Overall lifecycle score clamped to [0,100] from timeliness, response speed, activity_score*4, and complexity adaptation

columns.name: current_lifecycle_stage
columns.description: Stage label from ordered rules: backlog, newly_assigned, active_development, stagnant, completed_on_time, completed_delayed, or unknown_state

columns.name: anomaly_patterns
columns.description: Comma+space separated anomaly tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none

columns.name: success_patterns
columns.description: Comma+space separated success tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none

columns.name: improvement_opportunities
columns.description: Comma+space separated improvement tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none

columns.name: complexity_execution_match
columns.description: Execution speed vs complexity classification with first-match priority: appropriate_simple/medium/complex, faster_than_expected, slower_than_expected, within_range

columns.name: project_name
columns.description: Project name from stg_asana__project via project membership; null when no project

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: Team ID from the associated project; null when no project

columns.name: project_health_score
columns.description: Project overall health score (default 50 when project exists but no indicator); null when no project membership

columns.name: assignee_name
columns.description: Assignee user_name from stg_asana__user using the casted assignee_user_id join; null if no match

columns.name: assignee_performance_grade
columns.description: Assignee performance grade from user context; set to 'unknown' for any matched user by design

columns.name: relative_performance_vs_project
columns.description: Relative class vs project_health_score: above_project_average, slightly_above_average, project_average, slightly_below_average, below_project_average (null project treated as below_project_average)

columns.name: is_valid_record
columns.description: True if all data quality checks pass; the final result set filters to is_valid_record=true

      description: Team-level efficiency, performance, schedule, quality metrics, classifications, and ranks computed from Asana teams, projects, tasks, and users
      grain: One validated row per (team_id, team_name)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__team

      business_logic: '- Inputs and filters: - team_base: teams with non-null team_name. - project_base: projects with non-null team_id. - project_health_summary: project health fields with project_size_category defaulted to ''medium_project'' and schedule_forecast sourced from project_forecast. - user_basic_metrics: users with defaults performance_grade=''developing_performer'', workload_category=''normal_workload'', anomaly_flag=''normal'', risk_level=''low_risk'', portfolio_task_count=0, portfolio_overdue_tasks=0. - team_project_summary (per team_id, team_name; projects linked to health by project_id): - Project counts: - total_projects: number of unique projects. - active_projects: unique projects where project_status=''active''; projects without health data are not counted. - completed_projects: unique projects with completion_percentage=100. - overdue_projects: unique projects forecasted ''overdue''. - Averages over health fields (NULLs are ignored; result is NULL when no non-NULL values exist): - avg_project_health and avg_project_performance from overall_health_score. - avg_completion_rate from completion_percentage. - avg_quality_rate from quality_percentage. - avg_risk_percentage from risk_percentage. - Project size distribution: counts of projects by project_size_category among those with health data. - Defaults: total_team_tasks=0, completed_team_tasks=0, active_team_tasks=0, overdue_team_tasks=0, total_project_assignments=0, avg_tasks_per_assignee_across_projects=0.0, avg_project_velocity=0.5, avg_estimated_completion_days=30.0. - Percent metrics: - on_schedule_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique project, percentage of unique projects forecasted ''on_schedule'', rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - quality_completion_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique completed project, percentage of unique completed projects with overall_health_score>=80, rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - team_member_performance (per team via projects → project_task → task; only tasks with non-null assignee; users linked by assignee_user_id=user_id): - unique_team_members: number of distinct assignees. - Defaults: avg_member_performance=50.0, avg_member_completion_rate=75.0, avg_member_quality_rate=70.0. - Distributions (counts across task rows; a member appearing on multiple tasks is counted multiple times): top/high/solid/developing/underperformers by performance_grade; high_workload_members by workload_category=''high_workload''; high_risk_members by risk_level=''high_risk''. - avg_tasks_per_member: average of portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; NULL when no rows. - team_efficiency_scoring (join by team_id): - project_management_score (0–25): from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - quality_management_score (0–25): from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - collaboration_efficiency_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on performer mix shares ((top+high), then (top+high+solid), then underperformers); else 0; capped to [0,25]. - resource_optimization_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on shares of high_workload_members and high_risk_members; else 0; capped to [0,25]. - final_team_metrics: - overall_team_efficiency_score: sum of the four sub-scores (0–100). - efficiency_grade: thresholds on overall_team_efficiency_score (>=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient). - team_size_category: by unique_team_members (<=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team). - workload_balance_status: by share of high_workload_members (<=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced); ''no_data'' when no members. - team_maturity_level: by performer mix shares ((top+high) then (top+high+solid) then underperformers); ''undefined'' when no members. - improvement_recommendations: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - team_strengths: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - validated_team_metrics: - is_valid_record: true only when team_id and team_name are present; overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate are within [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects are non-negative; completed_projects does not exceed total_projects; unique_team_members is non-negative. - Ranks: efficiency_rank by overall_team_efficiency_score descending; performance_rank by avg_project_performance descending; schedule_reliability_rank by on_schedule_rate_pct descending; quality_rank by avg_quality_rate descending; ranks computed before filtering invalid rows. - Output: only rows with is_valid_record=true; ordered by overall_team_efficiency_score descending, then team_id.'

        description: Projects with size 'enterprise_project' among those with health data
      - name: large_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'large_project' among those with health data
      - name: medium_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'medium_project' among those with health data
      - name: small_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Projects with size 'small_project' among those with health data
      - name: total_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: completed_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: active_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: overdue_team_tasks
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: total_project_assignments
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 0
      - name: avg_tasks_per_assignee_across_projects
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 0.0
      - name: avg_project_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Constant 0.5
      - name: avg_estimated_completion_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 30.0
      - name: on_schedule_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of unique projects forecasted 'on_schedule', rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no projects
      - name: quality_completion_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of unique completed projects with health>=80, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none completed
      - name: unique_team_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct assignees on tasks linked to the team's projects; NULL assignees excluded
      - name: avg_member_performance
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 50.0
      - name: avg_member_completion_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 75.0
      - name: avg_member_quality_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Constant 70.0
      - name: top_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'top_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: high_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'high_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: solid_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'solid_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: developing_performers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'developing_performer'; duplicates by user across tasks are kept
      - name: underperformers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows where user grade is 'needs_improvement' or 'requires_support'; duplicates kept
      - name: high_workload_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows with user workload 'high_workload'; duplicates kept
      - name: high_risk_members
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Task rows with user risk 'high_risk'; duplicates kept
      - name: avg_tasks_per_member
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of user portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; typically 0 due to defaults; NULL when no rows
      - name: project_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]
      - name: quality_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]
      - name: collaboration_efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from performer mix among unique_team_members; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]
      - name: resource_optimization_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from high_workload and high_risk member shares; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]
      - name: overall_team_efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the four sub-scores in [0,100]
      - name: efficiency_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label from overall_team_efficiency_score: >=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient'
      - name: team_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Size by unique_team_members: <=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team'
      - name: workload_balance_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Balance by share of high_workload members: <=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced; ''no_data'' when no members'
      - name: team_maturity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Maturity by performer mix: >=60% top+high mature_team; else >=70% top+high+solid developing_team; else underperformers<=30% mixed_maturity; else needs_development; ''undefined'' when no members'
      - name: improvement_recommendations
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated suggestions built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none
      - name: team_strengths
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated strengths built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: 'True only if IDs present and metrics within bounds: overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate in [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects non-negative with completed_projects<=total_projects; unique_team_members non-negative; else false'
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by overall_team_efficiency_score descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: performance_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by avg_project_performance descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: schedule_reliability_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by on_schedule_rate_pct descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
      - name: quality_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank over all teams by avg_quality_rate descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows

columns.description: Task rows with user workload 'high_workload'; duplicates kept

columns.name: high_risk_members
columns.description: Task rows with user risk 'high_risk'; duplicates kept

columns.name: avg_tasks_per_member
columns.description: Average of user portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; typically 0 due to defaults; NULL when no rows

columns.name: project_management_score
columns.description: 0–25 score from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]

columns.name: quality_management_score
columns.description: 0–25 score from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]

columns.name: collaboration_efficiency_score
columns.description: 0–25 score from performer mix among unique_team_members; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]

columns.name: resource_optimization_score
columns.description: 0–25 score from high_workload and high_risk member shares; 0 when no members; capped to [0,25]

columns.name: overall_team_efficiency_score
columns.description: Sum of the four sub-scores in [0,100]

columns.name: efficiency_grade
columns.description: Label from overall_team_efficiency_score: >=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient

columns.name: team_size_category
columns.description: Size by unique_team_members: <=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team

columns.name: workload_balance_status
columns.description: Balance by share of high_workload members: <=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced; 'no_data' when no members

columns.name: team_maturity_level
columns.description: Maturity by performer mix: >=60% top+high mature_team; else >=70% top+high+solid developing_team; else underperformers<=30% mixed_maturity; else needs_development; 'undefined' when no members

columns.name: improvement_recommendations
columns.description: Comma-separated suggestions built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none

columns.name: team_strengths
columns.description: Comma-separated strengths built in fixed order and trimmed; empty when none

columns.name: is_valid_record
columns.description: True only if IDs present and metrics within bounds: overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate in [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects non-negative with completed_projects<=total_projects; unique_team_members non-negative; else false

columns.name: efficiency_rank
columns.description: Rank over all teams by overall_team_efficiency_score descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows

columns.name: performance_rank
columns.description: Rank over all teams by avg_project_performance descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows

columns.name: schedule_reliability_rank
columns.description: Rank over all teams by on_schedule_rate_pct descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows

columns.name: quality_rank
columns.description: Rank over all teams by avg_quality_rate descending (ties share rank); computed before filtering invalid rows
